title: MC vr+
description: This modpack makes immersion feel real without taking your fps and is playable with our without a vr so your friends can join to if they don't have or like vr.
body: My vr minecraft modpack aims to make vr minecraft optimized while having fun mods to play along with. The many mods I have chosen to make immersion feel real and not kill your fps are terralith, dungens & taverns, and overhauled villages. this makes the game feel almost as if your really there and with make up ultra fast shaders you'll really feel as if your in the world of minecraft. and if one of your friends doesn't have a vr than thats perfectly fine because this modpack works great without one. The modpack will work best on vr if it is streamed through steam vr.
